golden_sql.sql: WITH x AS ( SELECT r.WK_END_DT, c.CHNL_NM, SUM(IFF(p.BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA', r.TRX_QTY, 0)) AS lac, SUM(r.TRX_QTY) AS mkt FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.BIZ.MKT_DEF_DRIVER m ON m.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11 AND m.MKT_DEF = 'DRY_EYE' AND r.WK_END_DT BETWEEN m.EFF_FROM AND m.EFF_TO JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11 = r.PROD_NDC11 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.REF.CHNL c ON c.CHNL_CD = r.CHNL_CD WHERE r.WK_END_DT >= '2026-07-03' GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT CHNL_NM, SUM(lac) / SUM(mkt) AS share_13w, SUM(IFF(WK_END_DT <= '2026-07-24', lac, 0)) / SUM(IFF(WK_END_DT <= '2026-07-24', mkt, 0)) AS first4, SUM(IFF(WK_END_DT >= '2026-09-04', lac, 0)) / SUM(IFF(WK_END_DT >= '2026-09-04', mkt, 0)) AS last4 FROM x GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT p.BRAND_NM, SUM(IFF(c.ADJ_STAT = 'R', 1, 0)) / COUNT(*) AS rej_rate, COUNT(*) AS n FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11 = c.PROD_NDC11 WHERE p.CO_FLG = 'Y' AND c.ADJ_STAT IN ('P', 'R') AND c.CLM_DT >= '2026-06-27' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT r.REJ_GRP, COUNT(*) AS n, RATIO_TO_REPORT(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS pct FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT p ON p.PROD_NDC11 = c.PROD_NDC11 JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.REF.REJ_CODE r ON r.REJ_RSN_CD = c.REJ_RSN_CD WHERE p.BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA' AND c.ADJ_STAT = 'R' AND c.CLM_DT >= '2026-06-27' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT s.PLAN_NM, SUM(IFF(c.ADJ_STAT = 'R' AND r.REJ_GRP = 'PRIOR_AUTH', 1, 0)) / COUNT(*) AS pa_rate, SUM(IFF(c.ADJ_STAT = 'R' AND r.REJ_GRP = 'PRIOR_AUTH', 1, 0)) AS pa_rejects FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.CLMLNS_ADJ c JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PAYER_SPINE s ON s.PLAN_ID = c.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.REF.REJ_CODE r ON r.REJ_RSN_CD = c.REJ_RSN_CD WHERE c.PROD_NDC11 IN (SELECT PROD_NDC11 FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT WHERE BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA') AND c.ADJ_STAT IN ('P', 'R') AND c.CLM_DT >= '2026-06-27' GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

WITH qtd AS ( SELECT p.TERR_ID, SUM(r.TRX_QTY) AS trx, COUNT(DISTINCT r.WK_END_DT) AS wks FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY r JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = r.PRSCRBR_ME WHERE r.PROD_NDC11 IN (SELECT PROD_NDC11 FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT WHERE BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA') AND r.WK_END_DT >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', '2026-09-30'::DATE) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ro.REP_ID, ro.REP_NM, ro.TEAM, ro.TERR_ID, q.trx AS qtd_trx, g.TRX_GOAL, q.trx / (g.TRX_GOAL * q.wks / 13) AS attainment FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER ro JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.IC_GOAL g ON g.REP_ID = ro.REP_ID AND g.BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA' AND g.FQTR = '2026Q3' JOIN qtd q ON q.TERR_ID = ro.TERR_ID WHERE ro.DISTRICT_ID = 'D-03' ORDER BY attainment
